name: build
description: Hands-on tools that change code: implementer (applies approved review findings, spec units, or fix lists), test-engineer (finds the riskiest untested behavior and writes the missing tests), the fix-pr skill plus /fix-pr command (fetch, reason about, fix, reply, resolve, wait for CI, and approve PRs end-to-end), and the /implement command (route to implementer or tdd-workflow with the Deviations contract).
